The '''Hypergate Operation Center''' was the primary control center for the [[Grand Hypergate]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Asation]]. Located south of the [[Quadrilateral Forum]] and west of the [[hypergate]] itself, it was ran by the [[Master Control]] artificial intelligence, which was corrupted during [[Kephess]]'s raid on Asation. A hidden section of the center was called the Purple Obtuse Repository.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Harmonious Habitat first appears in the Operation "Terror From Beyond" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
